- [YouTube: Are Stablecoins the Next Big Thing? Luigi Mangione Terror Charges Dropped | The Weekly Wrap](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jPC3pD9j73A) - 2025-09-20
- [Substack: Are Stablecoins the Next Big Thing? Luigi Mangione Terror Charges Dropped | The Weekly Wrap](https://realeismanplaybook.substack.com/p/are-stablecoins-the-next-big-thing-388) - 2025-09-20

Earliest listed publication among matched versions, not proof of an unedited contemporaneous archive. Claim timestamps refer to the reviewed version.

## Summary

The September 19 wrap, uploaded September 20, evaluates stablecoin use cases and the difficulty of displacing card networks. It highlights reserve-yield economics, Tether counterparty risk and the importance of sector-specific valuation conventions.

The consumer-adoption analysis usefully separates merchant savings from consumer incentives. The account of perfectly stable reserves is wrong, Tether assurance is mislabeled as an audit, and migrant-remittance volume is overstated. His long-run adoption preferences remain conditional rather than proven stock calls.

## Material claims

<a id="youtube-jPC3pD9j73A-c001"></a>
### 001. Markets settle disagreements and therefore keep financial polarization from turning violent, unlike politics.

**Unresolved** | Steve Eisman | explanation | supporting

[Source at 1:54-3:08](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jPC3pD9j73A&t=114s) | Stance: asserted | Horizon: not stated

This broad causal social explanation is not established by market prices. Prices can remain disputed and do not serve as adjudication of every factual claim.

<a id="youtube-jPC3pD9j73A-c002"></a>
### 002. The Fed has cut 25 basis points and its projections imply two more cuts in 2025.

**Unresolved** | Steve Eisman | explanation | major

[Source at 3:15-3:40](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jPC3pD9j73A&t=195s) | Stance: reported | Horizon: not stated

The transcript reports the Fed decision and dot-plot interpretation, not a personal rate forecast. The exact meeting release was not separately inspected for this row.

Assessment test: Compare the September statement and median projection with subsequent decisions.


<a id="youtube-jPC3pD9j73A-c003"></a>
### 003. Bitcoin volatility makes a payment system built around it impossible.

**Wrong** | Steve Eisman | explanation | major

[Source at 5:14-5:36](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jPC3pD9j73A&t=314s) | Stance: asserted | Horizon: not stated

Price volatility creates conversion and balance-sheet risk, but does not logically prevent payments with immediate conversion or a separate unit of account.

Conditional reasoning: A sender can exchange a fixed local-currency amount for a volatile transfer asset, transfer it and immediately convert at the recipient. Volatility creates cost and risk, not logical impossibility.

Assessment test: Distinguish technical feasibility from commercial desirability and stable accounting units.


<a id="youtube-jPC3pD9j73A-c004"></a>
### 004. Short-term Treasury backing means USDC reserves and the coin value do not fluctuate.

**Wrong** | Steve Eisman | explanation | major

[Source at 5:38-6:16](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jPC3pD9j73A&t=338s) | Stance: asserted | Horizon: not stated

Short-term securities still have market-price risk and Circle acknowledged its 2023 de-peg and bank exposure.

Assessment test: Inspect reserve duration, liquidity and redemption channels.

- [USDC reserve risk and de-peg](https://www.circle.com/pressroom/3-3-billion-of-usdc-reserve-risk-removed-dollar-de-peg-closes) (2023-03-13): Circle acknowledged a USDC de-peg during the SVB episode and a $3.3 billion bank deposit exposure. Pegs and short-duration reserves are not a guarantee of constant market prices.

<a id="youtube-jPC3pD9j73A-c005"></a>
### 005. USDC use is about 50% trading, 25% dollarization, 20% DeFi and 5% remittances, with almost no consumer payments.

**Unresolved** | Steve Eisman | explanation | supporting

[Source at 6:42-8:25](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jPC3pD9j73A&t=402s) | Stance: asserted | Horizon: not stated

The estimates lack an identified measurement method, and on-chain wallet activity does not neatly identify economic use.

Assessment test: Find a dated, reproducible classification excluding internal transfers.


<a id="youtube-jPC3pD9j73A-c006"></a>
### 006. Dollar stablecoins can help users avoid unstable local currencies.

**Not testable** | Steve Eisman | explanation | major

[Source at 7:04-7:27](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jPC3pD9j73A&t=424s) | Stance: conditional | Horizon: not stated

This is a conditional use case, not a guarantee of preserved local or global purchasing power; dollar inflation and issuer risks remain.

Assessment test: Compare redemption access, exchange costs, dollar inflation and local restrictions.


<a id="youtube-jPC3pD9j73A-c007"></a>
### 007. DeFi can provide yield on USDC but without FDIC protection.

**Unresolved** | Steve Eisman | explanation | major

[Source at 7:31-7:43](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jPC3pD9j73A&t=451s) | Stance: asserted | Horizon: not stated

The risk distinction is sensible, but product-specific legal, contract and custody terms must be inspected. Yield comes from additional activities rather than automatic risk-free interest on every wallet balance.

Assessment test: Identify the lending or liquidity activity and the entity holding funds.


<a id="youtube-jPC3pD9j73A-c008"></a>
### 008. Cross-border payments are the more plausible early stablecoin opportunity because they can bypass costly chains of intermediaries.

**Unresolved** | Steve Eisman | investment thesis | major

[Source at 7:47-10:26](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jPC3pD9j73A&t=467s) | Stance: asserted | Horizon: not stated

Potential on-chain speed does not ensure end-to-end finality, cheap FX conversion or access to local money. The adoption thesis lacks a target date.

Assessment test: Measure all-in cost, settlement time, compliance and off-ramp liquidity.


<a id="youtube-jPC3pD9j73A-c009"></a>
### 009. Migrants sending money home represent roughly $3 trillion a year.

**Wrong** | Steve Eisman | explanation | supporting

[Source at 9:50-10:04](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jPC3pD9j73A&t=590s) | Stance: asserted | Horizon: not stated

The World Bank contemporary worldwide remittance estimate was about $905 billion for 2024. Broader cross-border person-to-person flows would be a different category.

Assessment test: Use consistent definitions of migrant remittances and broader transfers.

- [2024 remittance estimates](https://blogs.worldbank.org/en/peoplemove/in-2024--remittance-flows-to-low--and-middle-income-countries-ar) (2024-12-18): Estimated worldwide remittances were $905 billion, including $685 billion to low- and middle-income countries. This is much smaller than $3 trillion described as migrants sending money home.

<a id="youtube-jPC3pD9j73A-c010"></a>
### 010. Visa and Mastercard will be difficult to displace because of distribution, adaptability and incumbent partnerships.

**Not testable** | Steve Eisman | investment thesis | major

[Source at 10:26-11:59](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jPC3pD9j73A&t=626s) | Stance: asserted | Horizon: not stated

The mechanism is an investment framework without a specific market-share or time threshold. Historical survival is not proof that disruption is impossible.

Assessment test: Track share, partner economics, take rates and new rails over a defined horizon.


<a id="youtube-jPC3pD9j73A-c011"></a>
### 011. Cheaper merchant processing is insufficient by itself to persuade consumers to abandon convenient cards and rewards.

**Right** | Steve Eisman | analytical principle | major

[Source at 11:59-13:22](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jPC3pD9j73A&t=719s) | Stance: asserted | Horizon: not stated

A merchant saving does not automatically create a consumer incentive. The comparison must include rewards, credit, fraud handling and acceptance.

Conditional reasoning: A cost reduction for one participant changes another participant behavior only if transmitted through prices, rewards, convenience or another benefit. Merchant savings alone do not imply consumer adoption.

Assessment test: Model benefits and costs separately for merchant, consumer, issuer and network.


<a id="youtube-jPC3pD9j73A-c012"></a>
### 012. Consumers pay nothing for card payments, while merchants bear the entire cost.

**Mixed** | Steve Eisman | explanation | major

[Source at 12:18-13:02](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jPC3pD9j73A&t=738s) | Stance: asserted | Horizon: not stated

The statement is narrower if it means no explicit transaction charge at checkout. Economic costs can be reflected in retail prices, interest, annual fees or foregone discounts.

Conditional reasoning: The recipient of a processing invoice is not necessarily the sole bearer of the cost. Passing costs into prices or card charges can shift part of the burden to consumers.

Assessment test: Distinguish who remits a fee from who ultimately bears its economic cost.


<a id="youtube-jPC3pD9j73A-c013"></a>
### 013. A 100-basis-point decline in short rates could reduce Circle revenue by a double-digit percentage before circulation growth.

**Right** | Steve Eisman | explanation | major

[Source at 13:39-14:06](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jPC3pD9j73A&t=819s) | Stance: conditional | Horizon: not stated

Reserve income dominates and the conditional arithmetic is consistent with a several-percent starting yield. Actual total revenue also depends on balances and other revenue.

Assessment test: Hold reserve balances fixed and distinguish gross income from distribution costs.

- [Circle fourth-quarter and 2025 results](https://www.circle.com/pressroom/circle-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-fiscal-year-2025-financial-results) (2026-02-25): Q4 total revenue/reserve income $770m, +77%; USDC $75.3bn, +72%; reserve income $733m and other revenue $37m. Lower reserve yield partly offset circulation growth; therefore reserve interest is dominant but not the sole revenue source.

<a id="youtube-jPC3pD9j73A-c014"></a>
### 014. Tether is wholly unregulated and publishes an audited quarterly proof of reserves.

**Mixed** | Steve Eisman | explanation | major

[Source at 14:16-15:05](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jPC3pD9j73A&t=856s) | Stance: asserted | Horizon: not stated

It is not a US-regulated issuer, but held a Salvadoran license. Its published ISAE 3000 reserve assurance is not a full financial-statement audit. Both distinctions matter to the risk analysis.

Assessment test: Check regulator, legal entity, assurance scope and asset categories.

- [El Salvador issuer license](https://tether.io/news/tether-licensed-in-el-salvador-strengthening-focus-on-emerging-markets-and-innovation/) (2025-01-13): Tether announced a Salvadoran stablecoin-issuer and digital-asset-service license. Not being a US-regulated issuer is different from having no regulation.
- [Reserve assurance report](https://tether.io/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/ISAE_3000R_-_Opinion_TGRR_31.03.2025_RC187322025BD0035.pdf) (2025-05-01): The report is assurance on a specified reserves report under ISAE 3000, not a full financial-statement audit. Disclosed reserves include non-Treasury assets.

<a id="youtube-jPC3pD9j73A-c015"></a>
### 015. Tether alternative reserve assets could create a de-peg and damage confidence in competitors including Circle.

**Unresolved** | Steve Eisman | forecast | major

[Source at 15:00-15:30](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jPC3pD9j73A&t=900s) | Stance: conditional | Horizon: not stated

Reserve composition supports the risk mechanism, but this is a conditional contagion scenario without a deadline or loss trigger. Geographic location alone proves no wrongdoing.

Assessment test: Stress reserve liquidity, capital buffer, redemption behavior and contagion channels.

- [Tether first-quarter 2025 reserve statement](https://tether.io/news/tether-approaching-120b-in-u-s-treasuries-confirms-quarterly-operating-profit-over-1b-and-strengthens-global-usdt-demand-in-q1-2025/) (2025-05-01): The issuer disclosed gold and crypto exposure alongside Treasury exposure before the episode. Reserve assets were not exclusively short-term Treasuries.

This is a strategic preference, not a universal empirical result. Contrarian valuation can succeed or fail depending on catalyst and horizon.

## Framework and tools

- Ask who pays, who benefits and who must switch.
- Separate settlement technology from distribution and consumer incentives.
- Inspect reserve assets and redemption risk.
- Learn sector metrics without treating market convention as intrinsic truth.

Tools and charts discussed, not a complete visual inspection:

- Payments fee stack
- Use-case shares
- Reserve income sensitivity
- Reserve assurance reports
- P/E, EV/EBITDA and DCF

## Source cautions

Steve Eisman presents; speaker attribution follows the full dialogue.
- The opening political discussion is recorded as social commentary, not an investment forecast; allegations remain allegations.
- Stablecoin use-case percentage estimates have no cited dataset and are treated as unverified.
